He only wanted to help an old woman dig out of the snow.

Kevin Trudeau tells how, as a young guy during a blizzard, he grabbed a shovel to help a neighbor. He refused her payment, but she insisted.

Then he realized every house on the street had the same problem. He knocked on doors all weekend and earned more than his dad did in a full week at work.

That was the day Kevin saw what it means to work for yourself: find a need and fill it.

When did you last get paid for simply being useful?

#ad #money #success #mindset

Dream big, but don't be delusional. Then take the next step.

Kevin Trudeau says the successful people who mentored him were strict about this. You need a big dream, but then you must come back to today and ask what the next logical step is.

They taught two halves of success: attitude and action. Attitude alone is just daydreaming. Action alone has no direction.

Kevin compares it to two chemicals in a beaker. Put them together and things explode.

Which half are you stronger at, the dream or the action?

#ad #success #goals #mindset

The universe won't just deliver what you wish for, Kevin says.

Kevin Trudeau tells of a week at the Golden Door Spa, where men at the top of industry gathered. One was the founder of a huge hedge fund.

He noticed how differently they think, get motivated and act all day, compared with people who believe wishing is enough.

The gap in results, he says, comes from the gap in thinking and doing.

Do you believe wishing alone can change a life?

#ad #wealth #success #mindset

Rags-to-riches stories all shared one habit, Kevin says.

Kevin Trudeau says the people in those old stories first worked for someone successful. They were apprentices with a mentor, watching success in action.

Then they did more than they were paid to do. The old saying goes: do more than you're paid for, and soon you'll be paid more for what you do.

They went the extra mile.

Where in your life could you go one step beyond what's asked?

#ad #success #habits #mindset

Kevin wanted to learn how winners think, so he found them.

Kevin Trudeau tells how a school friend introduced him to a direct-selling company. Kevin wasn't after that business. He wanted to be around motivated, positive, inspired people.

They drove Cadillacs and Rolls-Royces and flew on private jets. He figured they knew something he didn't, so he set out to learn it.

Who are you spending time around right now?

#ad #success #mindset #habits

Starting a business used to take weeks and a big risk.

Kevin Trudeau remembers drawing ad layouts by hand, taking them to a printer, waiting weeks for the ad to run, and paying postage up front. Then you waited for replies.

Today, he says, everything is digital and online, and you can begin with very little.

He believes the internet has made it easier to start than at any time in history.

What would you start if the barrier were gone?
